spans.s: See under हुम्.
हुं—हुं-कार m. the exclamation हुं-हुम्, Lalit.
हुं-कृत &c. See हुम्.

हुं—कार m. the sound हुम् (esp. expressive of menace or contempt &c.; also applied to the trumpeting of an elephant, to the roaring or grunting &c. of other animals, to the twang of a bow &c.), MBh.; R. &c.
हुं—कारा (आ), f. N. of a Yoginī, Hcat.
हूं-कार, हूं-कृत. See under हुं, col. 2.
(only in 3. sg. Pot. हुनेत्) = √ 1. हु, to sacrifice, Pañcar.; Hcat.
in comp. for हुम्.
हुं—कारी (ई), f. id. or N. of a similar being, Pañcad.
हुं—कार—गर्भ mfn. filled with groaning or menacing sounds, MW.
हुं—कार—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, Cat.
हुं—कृत mfn. roaring, bellowing, bleating, VarBṛS.
addressed roughly (v.l. हूं-कृत), MBh.
uttered with a mystical sound, pronounced as an incantation, MW.
हुं—कृत n. an exclamation of anger, R.; BhP.
roar (of thunder), lowing (of a cow) &c., Kāv.
an incantation, MW.
or हूंहूंकार-प्रिय, m. N. of Śiva, MBh.
or हूंहूंकार-प्रिय, m. N. of Śiva, MBh.
(often incorrectly for हूण) a kind of gold coin current in the kingdom of Mādra (commonly called a Pagoda and worth about 8 shillings), MW.
